description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Drasan Ithbre)
- Vendor B (Luheskso Oznol)
- Vendor C (Nehesk Talmir)
- Vendor D (Beltir Quosan)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

Vendor A (Drasan Ithbre):
  - Vendor A has poor references from similar hospitals
  - Vendor A is financially stable
  - Vendor A has a stable engineering team
  - Vendor A is fully compliant with health-data regulations
  - Vendor A meets accessibility standards
  - Vendor A estimates deployment will take 16 months
Vendor B (Luheskso Oznol):
  - Vendor B passed an independent security audit
  - Vendor B allows no customisation
  - Vendor B refuses to include an uptime guarantee
  - Vendor B has strong references from similar hospitals
  - Vendor B meets accessibility standards
Vendor C (Nehesk Talmir):
  - Vendor C has high engineering staff turnover
  - Vendor C has unresolved compliance findings
  - Vendor C completed a successful pilot at a peer hospital
  - Vendor C has reported financial difficulties
  - Vendor C reported 8 major outages last year
  - Vendor C currently serves 4 hospital clients

  - Vendor D has poor references from similar hospitals
  - Vendor D guarantees 99.9% uptime in its contract
  - Vendor D imposes heavy penalties for contract exit
  - Vendor D currently serves 2 hospital clients
